#
# Editing this file by hand is fine; a future `rkd ci init` will report it as
# "modified" and will not overwrite it unless you pass --force.
name: Rocketdoo CI

on:
  pull_request: {}
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint addons
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install Rocketdoo and ruff
        run: pip install "rocketdoo~=3.5" ruff

      # An Odoo __manifest__.py is a bare dict literal by design, which ruff's
      # default rules report as B018 "useless expression" in every module.
      - name: Ruff check
        run: >
          ruff check --output-format=github --target-version py312
          --extend-per-file-ignores "**/__manifest__.py:B018"
          addons/

      - name: Validate module manifests
        run: rkd deploy validate -p addons


  # The install job is not generated for this project:

  # - Enterprise addons are not public.

  # Fix the underlying limitation and run `rkd ci init --force` to try again.
